856-5776-6277-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3585-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
3585-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 green Badger creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1385-1580-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-1580-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3175-8207.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

728-2558-3490-4659.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6719-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6719-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

567-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-4976-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-4976-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Open the Graves triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Berta triggers, adding {1}
Repeat.

549-2685-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-5641-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-955-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1526-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-4927.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4772-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4068-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
116-4068-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-5175-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5175-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-2999-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-2999-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

141-413-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Infuse with Vitality triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

147-2034-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-1272-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-1272-5674-5870.description:
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1462-2034-2905-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4316-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4316-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1872-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
You have a creature card in hand or in your graveyard that has a cycling ability and can be cast using {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
You are able to cast the creature card.
1872-2882-4999.description:
Cast the creature card with cycling either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate the creature by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
If you cast the creature from your graveyard, it is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing the creature's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If the creature has mana value 4 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1734-2150-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

342-499-2206-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Farrelite Priest and Gingerbrute.
Activate Gingerbrute by paying {0}, adding {W}.
Repeat step 3.

561-1284-4136-4831-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
561-1284-4136-4831-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, targeting Cacophodon.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Maestros Theater enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Roaring Earth.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cacophodon.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Mountain, Island or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Roaring Earth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

433-1636-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card on the battlefield that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
433-1636-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
The Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

404-969-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-969-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1247-1323-1494.notablePrerequisites:
Sage of Hours and Pili-Pala has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1323-1494.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2 until Experiment Kraj has five +1/+1 counters.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3510-3703.notablePrerequisites: An additional land card in hand.
2034-3510-3703.description:
Play a land.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that is also a Forest.
Repeat step 2 any number of times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar any number of times by sacrificing Sporemound and any number of Saprolings, adding any amount of colorless mana.
